reason: Our current chatbot gets ignored and answers badly, and this sits on top of it with no migration, so I can test it without ripping anything out. Growth at 49 EUR is nothing next to our revenue, and the refund if there's no lift makes it low risk.
objection: GDPR and what the bot does with our visitors' data, plus whether a bot taking actions on our site can go wrong or blow up the conversation count. The DPA and hard caps help, but I'd still read them before going live.
would_change_my_mind: A clear sub-processor list and DPA I can read before signing, and a quick look at a live demo trained on a real SaaS site. If the A/B report looked fake or the trial answers were wrong, I'd drop it.
